artist.name: Anjali Jain
artist.tagline: Crafting vivid stories on canvas, leather & more
artist.bio:
Anjali Jain crafts vivid stories on canvas, leather and more. Her wall moves easily between worlds — candlelit still lifes, blossom-crowned portraits, studies after the old masters, and landscapes that feel like a place you once called home. Every piece begins the same way: with a colour she cannot stop thinking about.

Inspired by everyday life and learning daily, she exhibits her work and welcomes commissions and collaborations — from paintings for the home to hand-painted leather bags and jackets. If something on this wall speaks to you, write to her; kind words always reach the studio.

works.title: Sakura
works.note: A face washed in blue, crowned in cherry blossom — one of the studio’s favourite walls of colour.

works.title: Honeycomb Reverie
works.note: Geometry swarming into thought — a butterfly settles where the eyes should be.

works.title: Flamenco Dancer
works.note: A pastiche — a flamenco dancer mid-turn, the whole canvas swirling with her.

works.title: Veiled in Autumn
works.note: A portrait dressed entirely in fallen leaves.

works.title: Vintage Spirits
works.note: A pastiche — a candlelit attic of bottles and jars, each one catching its own little flame.

works.title: Mary Gabrielle de Gramont
works.note: A pastiche in homage to Élisabeth Vigée-Le Brun, celebrating the elegance of her timeless portraits and keeping the spirit of nobility alive through the brush.

works.title: The Shepherd
works.note: A pastiche painted in deep chiaroscuro.

works.title: Home Beneath the Peaks
works.note: A stone path, grazing sheep and a timbered house under snow-capped mountains.

works.title: Blossom Face I
works.note: Concept study that later bloomed into the Sakura canvas.
